header.fold_rule: same landing page and under 13 conversions in 13 weeks

before_and_after.summary: 11 campaigns become 7. 7 of the 9 campaigns with a volume floor sit under it today; after the moves, 0 do. Brand moves fully into the brand campaign.

brand.why: Brand reviews bids only on brand terms. It is 16.4% of the campaign's spend but 28.8% of its conversions, which makes non-brand look like $75.34 a conversion when it is $88.46.

splits.service_sections: No campaign has two non-brand service sections, so no section could split off.

split_moves.move: Brand ad group out of General Dentistry | Search

ad_groups.action: rebuilt as its own ad group

after.verdict: Target Impression Share has no volume floor; the brand campaign keeps its strategy.

budget.why: The brand ad group spent $900 in 91 days, $9.89 a day, so $10 a day moves with it.

after.verdict: Without the brand ad group it has 52 conversions in 91 days, 17.1 per 30 days: under the 30 floor for its $90 target, so it switches to Maximize Conversions with no target (floor 15). Add a target back after it holds 30 per 30 days for four weeks. No other campaign shares its section, so there is nothing to merge it with.

carry_over.negatives_and_assets: A split: General Dentistry | Search's negatives and sitelinks stay with it, because they were written for its non-brand ad groups.
carry_over.brand_protection: General Dentistry | Search has no brand exclusion once its brand ad group leaves. Attach the existing 'Brand terms' list (it holds the brand term as a phrase negative) in Google Ads.

after.verdict: Together 97 conversions in 91 days, 32.0 per 30 days, clears the 30 floor of Target CPA with a target.

proposed_merges.target_change: Target CPA moves from $180 to $206, the pooled 91-day cost per conversion ($205.15) rounded up. Never tighter at the move; tighten after four clean weeks.

carry_over.locations_and_language: Same locations, language and location setting as Dental Implants | Search: part of the merge key.
carry_over.other_assets: The moving campaigns have no campaign-level assets other than sitelinks.

ad_schedule: Emergency Dentist Weekend | Search ran on Saturday, Sunday only. Emergency Dentist | Search has no schedule, so it already serves those hours; nothing to carry.

kept_apart.reason: No floor (Maximize Clicks), and no other campaign shares its section (/teeth-whitening/). 9 conversions at $322.22 each in 91 days: the bid strategy is the question here, not the structure.
Performance Max is a different campaign type and does not merge with Search. 55 conversions in 91 days (18.1 per 30 days) clears its floor of 15.

migration.build_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06: build everything paused, remove the blocking negatives, attach the lists, add the sitelinks.
migration.cutover_rule: One move per week, least 91-day spend first, each in one sitting: enable the new ad groups and ads, pause the old campaigns or ad groups, then change budget and strategy. Paused, never removed.
migration.learning_note: Adding ad groups changes what a bid strategy covers, so Google shows Learning for up to 7 days. Weeks 1 and 2 are watched, not judged.
